s1.quote: lies at depths ranging from approximately 5 metres at the shallowest to around 30 metres at the deepest sections … beach entry directly from the black volcanic shore

summary.text: Cargo ship wrecked off Tulamben, lying a short swim from the black-sand beach with its top about 5 m down and the stern reaching roughly 30 m. Easy shore entry and plenty of fish life make it Bali's classic wreck dive.

s1.quote: This shallow dive site, with depths ranging from 4 to 10 meters, … perfect for beginner divers and snorkelers because of its shallow depth

s2.quote: Most of this dive site is quite shallow with the best and brightest of the corals and macro activity at around 5 meters

summary.text: A shallow reef beside the Liberty wreck at Tulamben where the brightest coral and most macro life sit around 5 m, with the site only reaching about 10 m. Suited to beginners and snorkelers.

s1.quote: The wall starts at a depth of 3 meters and plunges down to 70 meters

s2.quote: The dive is shore entry and a short swim to a wall that eventually drops down to more than 70 meters

summary.text: A wall just a short swim from the Tulamben shore, beginning at about 3 m and dropping past 70 m. Divers usually stay on the shallower sponge- and gorgonian-covered upper face.

s1.quote: Shark point is probably the most popular dive in the Gili Islands … It slopes off into the Lombok Strait to over 50 metres. … At 5 metres there are always sea turtles feasting on the seagrass.

s2.quote: One of the steeper walls around the islands, Shark Point suits divers of any level. … advanced divers can reach depths of 100 feet (30 m) and more.

highlights.text: Turtles feeding on seagrass at about 5 m

summary.text: Popular slope off the northwest of Gili Trawangan, falling toward the Lombok Strait. Turtles graze the shallows and reef sharks are common, while experienced divers can drop to about 30 m.

s1.quote: Any level of diver can dive at Halik as the reef starts at just around 6 metres. … The gentle current here is ideal for drift diving. … For more advanced divers, the site drops to around 40 metres

s2.quote: Starting with beautifully formed corals in shallow water, this reef eventually turns into coral canyons as divers proceed deeper.

highlights.text: Gorgonian fans and massive barrel sponges

summary.text: Drift-friendly reef off Gili Trawangan that begins around 6 m with healthy coral and turns into canyons and ridges toward 40 m. A gentle current suits divers of most levels.

s1.quote: The wreckage now sits at an angle on the slope below and stretches from 32 to 66 feet (10 to 20 m). … there's often some current pushing divers along as well. … It offers plenty of hiding places for groupers and sweetlips
